battleTraits.name: A KINGDOM DELUDED
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: You must use this ability at the start of each turn. If it is the first turn of the battle, pick a DELUSION from these battle traits or, unless otherwise specified, from the warscroll of a friendly unit on the battlefield. If it is not the first turn, make a delusion roll of D6.
battleTraits.effect: On a delusion roll of 1-2, you must pick a different DELUSION to the one you picked last turn. On a 3-4, you must pick the same Delusion as the one you picked last turn, even if it is on the warscroll of a unit that has been destroyed. In such cases, the effect of that DELUSION applies as if the unit had not been destroyed. On a 5-6, you must pick a DELUSION like you did in the first turn. For the rest of the turn, you believe the DELUSION you picked.

battleTraits.name: A SPLENDID PAGEANT
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
While you believe this DELUSION:
• Each time a friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS unit wholly within 12" of a friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS HERO uses a RUN ability, if you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.
• While a friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS INFANTRY HERO is within the combat range of a friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS INFANTRY unit that has 5 or more models, that HERO is not visible to enemy units more than 6" away.

battleTraits.name: A GLORIOUS BANQUET
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: While you believe this DELUSION, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS units that charged in the same turn while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS HEROES.

battleTraits.name: ROYAL BLOOD
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick any number of friendly ABHORRANTS to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: Heal (D3) each target.

battleTraits.name: SUMMON LOYAL SUBJECTS
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly ABHORRANT to use this ability, then pick a friendly SERFS or KNIGHTS unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: MUSTER GUARD
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick any number of friendly NOBLES to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect:
For each target, pick 1 of the following:
• Return up to 3 slain models to a friendly SERFS unit wholly within 12" of it.
• Return 1 slain model to a friendly KNIGHTS unit wholly within 12" of it.
The same unit cannot have models returned to it by this ability more than once per turn.

battleTraits.name: FEEDING FRENZY
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS HERO in combat to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons, including Companion weapons, used by friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS units while they are wholly within 12" of the target.

battleTraits.name: ETHEREAL
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for friendly LEGIONS OF NAGASH NIGHTHAUNT units, excluding Nagash.

battleTraits.name: LEGIONS OF ENDLESS DEAD
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Subtract 5 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with 2 or more friendly units if any of those friendly units is Nagash or if none of those friendly units share any of the following keywords: SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS, FLESH-EATER COURTS, NIGHTHAUNT or OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS.

battleTraits.name: THE EQUINOX PARADE
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
In the first battle round:
• Add 1 to run rolls for friendly EQUINOX FEAST units for each other friendly EQUINOX FEAST unit that has used a RUN ability this phase.
• Add D6" to the distance friendly EQUINOX FEAST units can move when they use a RETREAT ability.

battleTraits.name: A DISPLAY OF FALCONRY
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
battleTraits.declare: You can only use this ability in the second battle round. Pick each enemy unit that used a CHARGE ability this phase to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

battleTraits.name: THE RITUAL DANCE
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: In the third battle round, while a friendly EQUINOX FEAST unit is in combat with an enemy unit that contains any champions, musicians or standard bearers, it can move 6" instead of 3" when it makes a pile-in move.

battleTraits.name: EAT YOUR FILL!
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
In the fourth battle round, each time a friendly EQUINOX FEAST unit uses a FIGHT ability, after that ability has been resolved:
• If that unit is damaged, Heal (D3) that unit.
• If that unit is not damaged, return up to 3 slain models to it.

battleTraits.name: MAKE MERRY ’TIL THE MORN
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: In the fifth battle round, friendly EQUINOX FEAST units have WARD (4+) while they are within 3" of 2 or more other visible friendly EQUINOX FEAST units.

battleTraits.name: THE SUMMERKING’S COLOURS
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly NEW SUMMERCOURT unit that contains any standard bearers to be the target.
battleTraits.effect:
For the rest of the battle:
• While the target unit contains any standard bearers, add 10 to the control scores of friendly NEW SUMMERCOURT units while they are wholly within 24" of the target.
• Once all of the standard bearers in the target unit have been slain, subtract 5 from the control scores of friendly NEW SUMMERCOURT units.

battleTraits.name: A DUEL, GOOD SIR!
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: You must use this ability if the friendly Ushoran is in combat with the enemy general. Pick the enemy general to be the target.
battleTraits.effect:
Your opponent must decide whether the target will accept or refuse Ushoran’s challenge.
Accept: For the rest of the turn, when the friendly Ushoran and the target are picked to use a FIGHT ability, all of their attacks must target each other.
Refuse: The target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: IN THEIR SIRE’S SHADOW
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Charge Phase
battleTraits.declare: If the friendly Ushoran is not in combat and has not used any RUN or RETREAT abilities this turn, pick him to use this ability. Then, pick up to 2 friendly NEW SUMMERCOURT KNIGHTS units within his combat range that are not in combat and have not used a RUN or RETREAT ability this turn to be his royal retinue. Then, make a charge roll of 2D6.
battleTraits.effect: The friendly Ushoran can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll. He can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and must end that move within ½" of a visible enemy unit. If he does so, he has charged. If he charged, then after this ability has been resolved, each unit in his royal retinue can immediately use the ‘Charge’ ability even if it is not your charge phase and you can use the charge roll from this ability instead of making a charge roll when it does so, but it must end the charge move within 3" of the friendly Ushoran.

battleTraits.name: THE KNIGHT’S VOW
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick each friendly NEW SUMMERCOURT unit that did not charge this turn to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: Start rolling dice, one at a time and one for each target, and stop when you roll a 6. The target you rolled a 6 for can use 2 FIGHT abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, the target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn. If you rolled for each target and did not roll a 6, this ability has no effect.

battleTraits.name: NIGHTMARISH CHARGE
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks that target friendly NEW SUMMERCOURT units that charged in the same turn.

battleTraits.name: RED ERRANTRY HOSTS
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly KNIGHTS unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within friendly territory, wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SOUND THE CHARGE
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly KNIGHTS that charged in the same turn while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS HEROES.

abilities.name: LIKE SNAPPING HOUNDS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick each friendly SERFS unit in combat to be the targets.
abilities.effect:
For each target:
• Make a pile-in move.
• Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: RAISE THE BANNERS
abilities.effect: Each time another ability returns at least 1 slain model to a friendly unit that is not in combat, after that ability has been resolved, if that unit is a SERFS unit, you can return 1 additional slain model to it, and if it is a KNIGHTS unit, roll a dice. On a 4+, you can return 1 additional slain model to it.

abilities.name: INDULGE, MY PRETTIES
abilities.effect:
While a friendly non-HERO FLESH-EATER COURTS MONSTER or BEAST is wholly within 12" of any friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS HEROES:
• That non-HERO unit can use a RAMPAGE ability on its warscroll even if that ability has already been used by another friendly MONSTER in the same turn.
• If that non-HERO unit charged in the same turn and the unmodified charge roll was 9+, it has STRIKE-FIRST for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: OVERWHELMING HORDES
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly SERFS unit that did not charge this turn and is in combat to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with that SERFS unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target cannot make pile-in moves for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: THE BLESSING OF THE CHALICE
abilities.effect: Friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS HEROES have WARD (5+) if they have destroyed a unit this battle.

entries.name: CHARNEL FEAST
entries.declare: Pick a friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS WIZARD to cast this spell and pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target. You can also pick a friendly SERFS unit within 6" of the target to be the raised ranks. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. For each damage point allocated to the target by this ability, you can return 1 slain model to the raised ranks.

entries.name: DERANGED TRANSFORMATION
entries.declare: Pick a friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS INFANTRY or CAVALRY unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
• Add 2" to the target’s Move characteristic.
• Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks.

entries.name: MIASMA OF MADNESS
entries.declare: Pick a friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, for each unmodified hit roll of 1 for a combat attack made by the target, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

entries.name: EXCOMMUNICATION!
entries.declare: Pick a friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 10+, ward rolls cannot be made for the target until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: CHARNEL CONVICTION
entries.declare: Pick a friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target has WARD (5+). If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.

entries.name: THE SUMMERKING’S FAVOUR
entries.declare: Pick a friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS HERO wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6. You cannot pick Nagash to be the target of this prayer.
entries.effect:
Resolve the effect of ‘Renowned Might’ below. If the chanting roll was 10+, resolve the effect of either ‘Renowned Might’ or ‘Righteous Tenacity’ instead.
Renowned Might: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
Righteous Tenacity: The target can use 2 FIGHT abilities this turn. After the first is used, however, the target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: SUMMON CADAVEROUS BARRICADE
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Cadaverous Barricade on the battlefield, pick a friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Cadaverous Barricade wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.

entries.name: SUMMON CORPSEMARE STAMPEDE
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Corpsemare Stampede on the battlefield, pick a friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Corpsemare Stampede wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: SUMMON CHALICE OF USHORAN
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Chalice of Ushoran on the battlefield, pick a friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Chalice of Ushoran wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

entries.name: Abhorrant Archregent

abilityDetails.name: Musicians, Play!
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While you believe this DELUSION, subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS units while they are wholly within 12" of a friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS HERO.

abilityDetails.name: Countless Servants
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a friendly SERFS or KNIGHTS unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+:
• If the target is a SERFS unit, you can return up to 3 slain models to that unit.
• If the target is a KNIGHTS unit, you can return 1 slain model to that unit.

entries.flavour: An Abhorrant Archregent rules over an entire empire of crazed cannibals. These vampires, amongst the oldest and most formidable of Ushoran’s brood, are unliving beacons of madness, commanding the devotion of innumerable ghouls.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Royal Attendant.

entries.name: Abhorrant Cardinal

abilityDetails.name: Insular Contemplations
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit is more than 6" from all enemy units, add 1 to chanting rolls for this unit.

abilityDetails.name: Banishing Liturgy
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: While you believe this DELUSION:
Add 2 to banishment rolls for friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS units.
Friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS units have WARD (4+) against damage points inflicted by SPELL abilities, PRAYER abilities and abilities used by MANIFESTATIONS.

entries.flavour: Abhorrant Cardinals seek to spread the glory of Ushoran across every land. Having drunk from the Carrion King’s chalice, they have gained a measure of unwitting control over the delusion, using bloody rites to stoke their flock’s rabid fury.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Royal Attendant.

entries.name: Abhorrant Ghoul King

abilityDetails.name: Code of Honour
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While you believe this DELUSION, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly non-UNIQUE FLESH-EATER COURTS HEROES for attacks that target an enemy HERO.

abilityDetails.name: Vassals, to Arms!
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a %000010870FIGHT ability% for this unit
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Pick a friendly SERFS unit that has not used a FIGHT ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the FIGHT ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: From ruling their subjects to serving as part of a sprawling, monstrous royal family, abhorrant vampires possess great power amongst the ghoulish courts. Many display a warped honour, hunting enemy champions to tear apart in single combat.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Royal Attendant.

entries.name: Abhorrant Ghoul King on Royal Terrorgheist

abilityDetails.name: Necromantic Limits
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: This unit’s Terrorgheist’s Skeletal Talons have a maximum Attacks characteristic of 10.
While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Terrorgheist’s Skeletal Talons is 4.

abilityDetails.name: Ferocious Hunger
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made with this unit’s Companion melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilityDetails.name: A Majestic Menagerie
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While you believe this DELUSION, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of Companion melee weapons used by friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS units while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS HEROES.

abilityDetails.name: Wicked Predator
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: For each champion, standard bearer and musician in the target unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s Terrorgheist’s Skeletal Talons, to a maximum of 10, for the rest of the phase. Those additional attacks must target that enemy unit.

melee: Crit (Mortal), Companion · See battle damage rules

entries.flavour: To an abhorrant vampire, their Terrorgheist steed appears as a glorious, white‑feathered lord of the sky. The reality is that these bat-like goliaths are ferocious and foul – traits that they share with their cannibal masters as they descend upon their prey.

entries.name: Abhorrant Ghoul King on Royal Zombie Dragon

abilityDetails.name: Necromantic Limits
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: This unit’s Draconic Claws have a maximum Attacks characteristic of 10.
While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Draconic Claws is 5.

abilityDetails.name: For The Kingdom!
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: While you believe this DELUSION, add 1 to charge rolls for friendly KNIGHTS units and friendly FLEASH-EATER COURTS MONSTERS while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly FLEASH-EATER COURTS HEROES.
Add 2 to charge rolls for friendly KNIGHTS units and friendly

abilityDetails.name: Monstrous Hunger
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While they are wholly within 12" of this unit, friendly non-HERO FLESH-EATER COURTS MONSTERS can use CHARGE abilities even if they used a RUN ability in the same turn.

abilityDetails.name: Draconic Terror
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Control characteristic, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

melee: Crit (Auto-wound), Companion · See battle damage rules

entries.flavour: To fly a noble drake into battle is the desire of many an abhorrant liege. Though these corpse-beasts are, in truth, rotting and pestilent, there is a certain morbid majesty to them that serves to stoke the hunger of their fellow undead beasts.

entries.name: Abhorrant Gorewarden

abilityDetails.name: Lord of the Marches
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick this unit and up to 2 friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS units in this unit’s regiment that have not been deployed to be the targets.
Effect: Set up the target units in reserve patrolling the borders. They have now been deployed.

abilityDetails.name: Trespassers!
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick this unit if it is patrolling the borders, then pick an enemy unit to be the target.
Effect: Set up this unit more than 6" from the target and more than 9" from all other enemy units. Then, set up the units that were patrolling the borders with this unit wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilityDetails.name: Defenders of the Kingdom
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: While you believe this DELUSION and this unit is on the battlefield, add 1 to charge rolls for friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS units while they are wholly within 12" of a friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS HERO. Add 2 to charge rolls instead if they were also set up in the same turn.
When using the ‘A Kingdom Deluded’ ability, you can pick this DELUSION even if this unit is patrolling the borders.

entries.flavour: Gorewardens bear the keys to the kingdom and oversee the protection of their liege’s borderlands. Clad in what they perceive to be great finery, they lead flights of bloodthirsty predators to savage unwary intruders.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Royal Attendant.

entries.name: Cadaverous Barricade

abilityDetails.name: Grasping Hands
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: Enemy units cannot use RUN or RETREAT abilities while they are within this MANIFESTATION’s combat range.
In addition, if an enemy unit is picked to use a MOVE ability while it is within this MANIFESTATION’s combat range, halve that unit’s Move characteristic (rounding up) for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: With a word of command, the buried dead are brought writhing to the surface. The corpses of those who once served Ushoran rise up from the grave, dragging with them the detritus of forgotten civilisation and clawing at those who draw too near.

entries.name: Chalice of Ushoran

abilityDetails.name: Draughts of Delusion
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit within 6" of this MANIFESTATION to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, your opponent must pick 1 of the following to apply for the rest of the turn:
Drink Deep from the Chalice: Other than the Companion weapon ability, weapon abilities for attacks made by the target have no effect.
Turn Aside and Suffer the Consequences: Combat attacks that target that enemy unit score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

entries.flavour: Believed to be a manifestation of the sacred cup held by Ushoran, this bone-wrought goblet is continually filled with the blood of those slain in its presence. One sip will see minds twist and reality distort, but to refuse to drink is to invoke the ghouls’ wrath.

entries.name: Charnel Throne

abilityDetails.name: Reigning Champion
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this terrain feature does not have a Steward, pick a friendly FLESH‐EATER COURTS INFANTRY HERO within 3" of it and not in combat to be the target.
Effect: Place the target on this terrain feature. The target is now the Steward (see ‘Steward of the Realm’).

abilityDetails.name: Duty Calls
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If this terrain feature has a Steward that was not placed on it this turn, set up the Steward on the battlefield wholly within 6" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer the Steward.

abilityDetails.name: Ruler of All They Survey
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this terrain feature has a Steward, pick a visible friendly non-HERO FLESH-EATER COURTS unit that is not in combat to be the target.
Effect: The target can move D3". If the target was set up this turn, it can move D6" instead. It cannot move into combat during that move.

abilityDetails.name: Steward of the Realm
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: While this terrain feature has a Steward:
• The Steward cannot use MOVE abilities.
• Instead of measuring range or visibility to the Steward, measure to this terrain feature instead.
• All attacks that would target the Steward target this terrain feature instead.
• If this terrain feature is destroyed, before removing it from the battlefield, inflict D3 mortal damage on the Steward. Then, set up the Steward on the battlefield within 3" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer the Steward. If it is not possible to set up the Steward, it is slain.

entries.flavour: Formed from the bones of those killed by an abhorrant, Charnel Thrones exude madness and necrotic energies. They are seats of power for Archregents and Ghoul Kings, blazing beacons to mordants and structures of abject horror for the enemies of the Flesh-eaters.
entries.description:
The following universal terrain abilities apply to this terrain feature (Terrain, 1.2):
Cover, Impassable

entries.name: Corpsemare Stampede

abilityDetails.name: Trampled Underfoot
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: This MANIFESTATION can use this ability even if it is in combat.
Pick a point on a battlefield edge to be the target. Then, make a stampede roll of 2D6. Add 1D6 to the roll for each battle round that this MANIFESTATION has been on the battlefield and has not been banished. For example, the stampede roll would be 2D6 in the turn in which it was summoned, 3D6 in your next turn, and so on.
Effect: This MANIFESTATION can move a distance up to the value of the stampede roll in a straight line directly towards the target. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units. It cannot end that move in combat unless it ends that move within ½" of a

entries.flavour: Imparted with grisly vigour by the insane magics of the abhorrants, the undead beasts of a Corpsemare Stampede burst from the blood-soaked ground. Once loosed, they trample across the battlefield with reckless abandon, crushing any foolish enough to be caught in their path.

entries.name: Crypt Flayers

abilityDetails.name: To Our Liege!
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If this unit is not in combat, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 12" of a friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS HERO and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.flavour: Having gorged on the flesh of monsters and the blood of vampires, Crypt Flayers have mutated into winged abominations. Other ghouls exalt them for their boldness and the ‘purity’ of their voices – sonic screeches that can burst eardrums.

entries.name: Crypt Flayers (2 models)

abilityDetails.name: To Our Liege!
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If this unit is not in combat, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 12" of a friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS HERO and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.flavour: Having gorged on the flesh of monsters and the blood of vampires, Crypt Flayers have mutated into winged abominations. Other ghouls exalt them for their boldness and the ‘purity’ of their voices – sonic screeches that can burst eardrums.
entries.notes: You can include 1 unit of this type for each Crypt Infernal Courtier in your army. This unit cannot be reinforced.

entries.name: Crypt Ghast Courtier

abilityDetails.name: Marshal of the Peasantry
abilityDetails.timing: Reaction: You declared a %000010870FIGHT ability% for this unit
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Pick a friendly Crypt Ghouls unit that has not used a FIGHT ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the FIGHT ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: Amongst the lowliest of an abhorrant’s courtiers, Crypt Ghasts are nevertheless vicious and cunning creatures. They rally behind them great throngs of snarling cannibals, leading them into battle with howls of murderous fury.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Flesh-eater Noble.

entries.name: Crypt Ghouls

abilityDetails.name: Royal Approval
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons while it is wholly within 12" of any friendly NOBLES or ABHORRANTS.

entries.flavour: Crypt Ghouls form the lowly and indentured serfs of an abhorrant's domain. Though they are individually stunted and wild, their madness grants them a fiendish form of courage, and in numbers, they can overwhelm even the mightiest warriors.

entries.name: Crypt Haunter Courtier

abilityDetails.name: Blessed Blood
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Heal (D3) this unit.

abilityDetails.name: Knightly Exemplar
abilityDetails.timing: Reaction: You declared a %000010870FIGHT ability% for this unit
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Pick a friendly Crypt Horrors unit that has not used a FIGHT ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the FIGHT ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

melee: Massive Bone Club and Rancid Talons

entries.flavour: Masters of a kingdom’s knightly echelons, Crypt Haunters are amongst the most physically powerful of an abhorrant’s courtiers. They lead their misbegotten kin in bone-crunching charges and revel in tearing foes limb from bloody limb.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Royal Attendant.

entries.name: Crypt Horrors

abilityDetails.name: Holy Blades of Bone
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll 2 dice for each model in this unit. Add 2 to each roll if the target is CAVALRY. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

entries.flavour: Creatures of truly imposing size and might, Crypt Horrors are formidable linebreakers. In their own minds, they are valorous knights, and their hunger to perform worthy deeds under their lord’s gaze drives them into a rabid frenzy.

entries.name: Crypt Horrors (2 models)

abilityDetails.name: Holy Blades of Bone
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll 2 dice for each model in this unit. Add 2 to each roll if the target is CAVALRY. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

entries.flavour: Creatures of truly imposing size and might, Crypt Horrors are formidable linebreakers. In their own minds, they are valorous knights, and their hunger to perform worthy deeds under their lord’s gaze drives them into a rabid frenzy.
entries.notes: You can include 1 unit of this type for each Crypt Haunter Courtier in your army. This unit cannot be reinforced.

entries.name: Crypt Infernal Courtier

abilityDetails.name: On Winged Steeds
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a friendly Crypt Flayers unit that used the ‘To Our Liege!’ ability this turn and is wholly within 9" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: The target can immediately move D3" but cannot end that move in combat.

abilityDetails.name: Mind-shattering Cacophony
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by attacks made with this unit’s Piercing Death Screech to be the target.
Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of ranged weapons used by friendly Crypt Flayers units for attacks that target that enemy unit.

entries.flavour: Crypt Infernals are terrors of the skies and often lead the bodyguard of an abhorrant monarch. Blessed with leathery wings, they soar upon thermals and keep watch for the enemy - upon sighting them, they let loose a sonic bombardment that blasts the mind.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Royal Attendant.

entries.name: Cryptguard

abilityDetails.name: Royal Bodyguard
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While any friendly non-MONSTER FLESH-EATER COURTS HEROES are wholly within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those HEROES have WARD (5+).

abilityDetails.name: Elite Guardians
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If this unit is in combat with any enemy units that charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, this unit has STRIKE-FIRST but ward rolls cannot be made for it.

entries.flavour: To join the Cryptguard, a ghoul must perform some great feat of endurance in the sight of their vampiric liege. Charged with protecting their unholy masters, they wield weapons from the monarch’s armoury – rusted blades inundated with maddening energies.

entries.name: Grand Justice Gormayne

abilityDetails.name: Arrest Those Miscreants!
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target has STRIKE-LAST while it is in combat with any friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS HEROES and any friendly SERFS or KNIGHTS units.

abilityDetails.name: Accusations of Regicide
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While you believe this DELUSION, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly SERFS and KNIGHTS units while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS HEROES that had any damage points allocated to them in the same turn.

entries.flavour: Grand Justice Gormayne ensures that the Carrion Kings insane laws are followed and those who transgress are punished. A cunning orator, he spurs his ghoulish jury' into a frothing rage, condemning foes to be bloodily torn apart.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Royal Attendant.

entries.name: High Falconer Felgryn

abilityDetails.name: Be Mine Eyes
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: This unit’s Grype is a token. If this unit’s Grype is not next to an enemy unit, pick an enemy unit within 18" of this unit and not in combat to be the target.
Effect: Place this unit’s Grype next to the target. If the target is destroyed while this unit’s Grype is next to it, remove this unit’s Grype from the battlefield.

abilityDetails.name: Winged Reconnoitrer
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit’s Grype is next to an enemy unit, ward rolls cannot be made for damage points inflicted on that enemy unit by combat attacks made by this unit and friendly SERFS units.

abilityDetails.name: Sir Felgryn is Abroad!
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While you believe this DELUSION, subtract 10 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with any friendly SERFS units or any friendly non-HERO FLESH-EATER COURTS MONSTER or BEAST units.

entries.flavour: Beloved by the serf masses and reviled by his fellow abhorrants, Felgryn is an especially beastly example of an already monstrous lineage. It is fitting that this blood-crazed vampire has a particular affinity with wild creatures; these delusion-wracked beasts heed his garbled commands, spying hidden foes and setting on them with flashing talons.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Royal Attendant.

entries.name: Marrowscroll Herald

abilityDetails.name: The King’s Entreaty
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Charge Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, your opponent must decide whether the target will accept or reject the entreaty offered by this unit.
Accept: The target has the INFECTED keyword for the rest of the battle.
Reject: The target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

abilityDetails.name: Infected
abilityDetails.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a command, SPELL ability or PRAYER ability for an INFECTED unit
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 5+:
• If they declared a command, that command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.
• If they declared a SPELL or PRAYER ability, that spell or prayer fails.
This reaction can be used more than once per phase but only once per command, SPELL ability or PRAYER ability.

entries.flavour: Marrowscroll Heralds are senior delegates of the court, sent to deliver entreaties to the other nations of the realms. In doing so, they spread the curse of Ushoran far and wide, leaving desolation and madness in their wake.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Royal Attendant.

entries.name: Morbheg Knights

abilityDetails.name: Predator Knights
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Enemy Turn
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, this unit can use a RETREAT ability as if it were your movement phase. No mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by that RETREAT ability.

entries.flavour: The grisly cavaliers known as Morbheg Knights are amongst the proudest of a court’s warriors. They bound to battle atop the half-living nightshriekers, hideous spawn of the ur-bat Morbheg.

entries.name: Nagash, Supreme Lord of the Undead

abilityDetails.name: Battle Damaged
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, subtract 3 from its power level.

abilityDetails.name: Utter Contempt
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit ignores the effects of DELUSION abilities.

abilityDetails.name: The Staff of Power
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Add 2 to casting rolls for this unit while it has not miscast any spells this turn. If this unit miscasts a spell, ignore the restriction that would stop this unit from casting any more spells this turn.

abilityDetails.name: Hand of Dust
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy HERO or MONSTER in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Hide a dice in one of your hands or under one of two appropriate containers. Your opponent must pick one of your hands or containers. If they pick the one hiding the dice, this ability has no effect. If they pick the empty one, the target is automatically destroyed.

abilityDetails.name: Invocation of Nagash
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: This unit can cast this spell more than once per phase. Pick a visible unit wholly within 18" of this unit that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
Effect: If the target is an enemy unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on it. If the target is a friendly DEATH unit, pick 1 of the following effects:
• Return a number of slain models to the target unit with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.
• The target has WARD (5+) until the start of your next turn.

abilityDetails.name: Supreme Lord of the Undead
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO NON-UNIQUE DEATH unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
Effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.flavour: All living beings dread the name of Nagash, the God of Undeath. Cruel and tyrannical, the overlord of Shyish intends to conquer the Mortal Realms and transform them into a lifeless Necrotopia, in which not a speck of dust moves unless it is by his will.

entries.name: Royal Beastflayers

abilityDetails.name: Hunter’s Instincts
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: Enemy MONSTERS cannot use RAMPAGE abilities while they are in combat with this unit.
In addition, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of melee weapons used by enemy MONSTERS and BEAST units while they are in combat with this unit.

entries.flavour: Led by vampiric Flaymasters, the Royal Beastflayers are obsessed with hunting the monsters that lurk throughout the realms. It matters not if their prey are genuine abominations or noble beasts – all make for a fine banquet indeed.

entries.name: Royal Decapitator

abilityDetails.name: Executioner’s Entourage
abilityDetails.timing: Reaction: You declared a %000010870FIGHT ability% for this unit
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Pick a friendly SERFS unit that has not used a FIGHT ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the FIGHT ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, the target’s melee weapons have Crit (2 Hits) for the rest of the turn.

abilityDetails.name: Off With Their Head!
abilityDetails.timing: Reaction: You declared a %000010870FIGHT ability% for this unit
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Immediately after that FIGHT ability has been resolved, pick an enemy INFANTRY HERO in combat with this unit to be the target. Roll 2D6. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, it is automatically destroyed.

entries.flavour: Viewed with unease even by fellow ghouls, the Royal Decapitators care only for the dealing of death. Dragging huge, tarnished axes behind them, they serve their lieges as gibbering executioners and delight in taking worthy heads.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Royal Attendant.

entries.name: Royal Terrorgheist

abilityDetails.name: Necromantic Limits
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: This unit’s Skeletal Talons have a maximum Attacks characteristic of 10.
While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Skeletal Talons is 4.

abilityDetails.name: Shriek of Terror
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy INFANTRY unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If 3 or more damage points are allocated to the target by this ability, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilityDetails.name: Wicked Predator
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: For each champion, standard bearer and musician in the target unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s Skeletal Talons, to a maximum of 10, for the rest of the phase. Those additional attacks must target that enemy unit.

melee: Crit (Mortal), Companion · See battle damage rules

entries.flavour: Terrorgheists are the rotten, reanimated carcasses of ancient chiropteran titans, as bitter and sinister in life as they are in death. Consumed by hunger, their screams blast free of their vile bodies, shredding the very souls of any who hear them.

entries.name: Royal Zombie Dragon

abilityDetails.name: Necromantic Limits
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: This unit’s Draconic Claws have a maximum Attacks characteristic of 10.
While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Draconic Claws is 5.

abilityDetails.name: On Rotten Wings
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set up it again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilityDetails.name: Soaring Terror
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If this unit charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can move 2D6". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move in combat. Then, pick an enemy unit that this unit passed across during that move. Inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

melee: Crit (Auto-wound), Companion · See battle damage rules

entries.flavour: A Zombie Dragon forms the crown jewel of any abhorrant’s royal menagerie, though these creatures inspire more revulsion than awe in sane folk. They circle above their prey before arrowing down into battle, a wave of charnel stink and horror stretching out before them.

entries.name: Scourge of Aqshy Royal Decapitator

abilityDetails.name: EXECUTIONER AND ENFORCER
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick another friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS INFANTRY unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
Effect: 1 model in the target unit is automatically slain. Then, until the start of your next turn, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to each visible friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS unit in each phase while it is wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilityDetails.name: HEADS ON PIKES
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If any damage points were allocated to an enemy HERO by this unit’s combat attacks this turn and that enemy HERO has been destroyed, pick an objective or terrain feature within 6" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: Spend 1 rage dice. If your opponent’s fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, for the rest of the turn, subtract 5 from the control scores of enemy units while they are

entries.flavour: The axes wielded by the headsmen of the courts hunger for slaughter, and the Royal Decapitators are quick to satiate them, cleaving worthy heads from their bodies as they traverse the Great Parch.
entries.notes:
This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Royal Attendant.
This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the General’s Handbook 2026-27 battlepack.

entries.name: Scourge of Aqshy Varghulf Courtier

abilityDetails.name: Beast
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilityDetails.name: The Howling Saint
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS PRIEST wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: The next time the target uses a PRAYER ability this phase:
• When picking targets for that prayer, you can measure range and visibility from this unit instead of from the chanter.
• Add 1 to the chanting roll for that prayer.

entries.flavour: Viewed as saintly champions by the ghouls in their shared delusion, in reality, Varghulfs are utterly feral vampiric monstrosities. Their bestial nature reflected in their unholy form, Varghulfs stalk the plains of Aqshy in search of fresh meat.
entries.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the General’s Handbook 2026-27 battlepack.

entries.name: Scourge of Ghyran Abhorrant Ghoul King

abilityDetails.name: The Kings Court
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by other friendly non-MONSTER FLESH-EATER COURTS HEROES while they are wholly within 12" of this unit. In addition, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for each other friendly NON-MONSTER FLESH-EATER COURTS HERO wholly within 12" of this unit, to a maximum of +3.

abilityDetails.name: Long Live the King
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, friendly non-UNIQUE FLESH-EATER COURTS units wholly within 12" of this unit become enraged until the start of your next turn. Melee weapons used by friendly enraged units have Crit (Auto-wound) and score critical hits on unmodied hit rolls of 5+, even if this unit has been destroyed.

entries.flavour: Utterly deranged, the Abhorrant Ghoul Kings of the Everspring Swathe believe themselves to be good and just rulers of forest kingdoms, rather than the flesh-eating nightmares they truly are. Their cadaverous minions are equally deluded. Such is their devotion to their vampiric master that should the Ghoul King fall they will enter a berserk rage, ripping and tearing those responsible to shreds.
entries.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the General’s Handbook 2025-26 battlepack.

entries.name: Scourge of Ghyran Abhorrant Gorewarden

abilityDetails.name: Glorious Charge
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly KNIGHTS unit and has charged this turn, this unit has WARD (5+) and its Gory Talons and Fangs have Charge (+1 Damage).

abilityDetails.name: Swooping Descent
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Enemy Turn
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield, then set it up again more than 9" from all enemy units and either:
• Wholly within 6" of the edge of the battlefield, or
• Within 3" of an objective you do not control.

entries.flavour: Flying terrors on tattered wings, Abhorrant Gorewardens patrol the mordant kingdoms of Ghyran, seeking intruders or precious relics that their liege might desire. Should they spot such a target they will descend in a screeching dive, reclaiming the lands in the name of their Ghoul King and disembowelling any trespassers with raking talons.
entries.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the General’s Handbook 2025-26 battlepack.

entries.name: The Grymwatch

abilityDetails.name: Quest to Slay the Monster
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: For the rest of the turn, while this unit is in combat with any enemy MONSTER or BEAST units, it has STRIKE-FIRST. However, for the rest of the turn, while it is in combat with any enemy MONSTER or BEAST units, all of this unit’s combat attacks must target an enemy MONSTER or BEAST unit.

entries.flavour: Duke Crakmarrow is the liege-lord of the Grymwatch. This cadaverous creature is seen as an example of glorious gallantry by his kin and a blood-spattered, carrion-devouring monstrosity by the foes he meets in battle. Believing themselves to be heroic paladins on a mission of the utmost import, the deluded cannibals of the Grymwatch scrabble forth to tear apart their foes in a flurry of fangs and grasping claws.
entries.description:
The models in this unit are:
• Duke Crakmarrow (champion, armed with a Great Halberd)
• Gristlewel (armed with Knightly Weapons)
• Valreek the Tracker (armed with Knightly Weapons)
• The Royal Butcher (armed with Knightly Weapons)
• Master Talon (armed with Knightly Weapons)
• The Night’s Herald (armed with Knightly Weapons)
• The Duke’s Harriers (armed with Knightly Weapons)

entries.name: The Skinnerkin

abilityDetails.name: Prime Cuts
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Each time a combat attack made by this unit scores a critical hit, give 1 prime cut point to this unit, to a maximum of 6.

abilityDetails.name: Dinner is Served
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS HERO wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: Heal (X) the target, where X is the number of prime cut points this unit has. Then, reset this unit’s prime cut points to 0.

entries.flavour: Foremost of the Summerking’s butchers are the Skinnerkin, who work to secure the most delicious viands for his feasts. These masters of the slaughter carry racks of meat hooks in their very flesh, intent on stringing up their prey upon these blades alive – for the sake of freshness, of course.
entries.description:
Each model in this unit is armed with Butchering Weapons. The models in this unit are:
• Gristla Tenderhooke (champion)
• The Carnskyr
• Seddrik the Chain
• Young Master Kretch
• Flensemaster Pewdrig

entries.name: Ushoran, Mortarch of Delusion

abilityDetails.name: Battle Damaged
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Monstrous Talons is 4.

abilityDetails.name: The One True King
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: While you believe this DELUSION:
• Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS units.
• Subtract 1 from run rolls and charge rolls for enemy units.
• The melee weapons used by friendly SERFS units have Anti-charge (+1 Rend) while they are wholly within friendly territory and did not charge in the same turn.

abilityDetails.name: Epicentre of Delusion
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Each time you make a delusion roll, you can add 1 to or subtract 1 from the roll.

abilityDetails.name: Glimpse of Delusion
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy model within 18" of this unit to be the target, pick an enemy unit that is visible to the target and within the target’s combat range to be the victim, then make a casting roll of 2D6. You can only pick the target’s unit to be the victim if that unit has 2 or more models.
Effect: Pick 1 of the target’s melee weapons. Immediately resolve combat attacks for the target made with that weapon against the victim.

abilityDetails.name: Shroudcage Fragment
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with this unit to be the targets.
Effect: Roll a dice for each target. If the roll exceeds the target’s Control characteristic, the target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: An ancient and monstrous lord amongst vampires, Ushoran is one of the most dreaded of Nagash’s Mortarch servants. He is a font of cursed madness, escalating the mania of his ghoul servants even as he annihilates foes with talon and gore-splattered sceptre.

entries.name: Varghulf Courtier

abilityDetails.name: Beast
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilityDetails.name: Victory Feast
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: If any models were slain by this unit this turn:
• Heal (D6) this unit.
• If this unit is in combat, this unit can immediately move 10". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move in combat with the units it was already in combat with at the start of the move.
• If this unit is not in combat, this unit can immediately move 10" but cannot end that move in combat.

entries.flavour: Varghulfs are the most degenerate of all Ushoran’s vampiric brood, their bestial nature reflected in their unholy form. Nevertheless, to the ghouls, the Varghulfs are saintly champions indeed, and they follow them to battle with a rapturous joy.
